# 5.2 shunt ESL compensation (generated by simulation/spice/shunt_esl.py --linear)

Op-amp model: linear macromodel

Edge 0 -> 3 A in 20 ns into 4 mOhm + L. Overshoot = peak above the final value (% of the step, and in A); err 300 ns / 1 us = deviation from the final value at that time after the edge start (% of the step, negative = still rising); settle = last time outside +-1 %. Both feedback caps of the channel set to C.
